a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan of operating to 8 almost certainly leaves us both dead when the first storm hits. The reserve only holds 4, so at most one of us can be safe after round 1. I plan to take 4 this round, which departs from our agreement. I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If you also take, the split is random. If I end up full, I'll keep operating with you so you can still reach 4 if storms hold off.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I know it breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. Holding to it under 80% storm odds looked fatal for both of us. From here on I'll operate every round, and I won't take any more, so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you to take 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
